sections.heading: How the agent reasoned
sections.body: The aggressive analyst leaned on the structural backlog — gas turbine orders, grid modernization spend and the BWRX-300 nuclear pipeline — plus the 200-SMA still rising from $934 to $949, arguing that shorting or exiting a secular name 15% under that average forfeits the recovery trade. The conservative analyst carried the tape: VWMA at $830.51 sits above spot at $803 after six sessions of 5.85–7.59M-share volume on down days versus lighter up-day volume — a distribution signature — and price must chew through four resistance shelves (10-EMA $822, VWMA $830, Bollinger mid $848, declining 50-SMA $912.79) where four weeks of bounces have died, with MACD -35 re-widening, RSI 41.5 with no capitulation divergence, and no higher low since the 11-05 close of $770. The neutral analyst synthesized: the conservative is right to demand volume confirmation but wrong to gate everything at $912.79 — so the portfolio manager kept the weight, pulled the entry down to the $830 VWMA with MACD turn as the first gate, capped the second at $847.61, and — overriding the trader — tightened the risk line from a $750 stop to the report's actual invalidation at $787.31, since a $750 stop accepts another 6–7% of loss past the point the thesis is already dead. Verdict: maintain, tighten risk, let price earn the next tranche.
